stratagem.name: STRIKE FROM THE SHADOWS
stratagem.lore: To evade one’s enemies and sow confusion can be a deadly weapon in itself.
stratagem.when: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when a friendly hidden PHOBOS unit is selected to attack.
stratagem.effect: Your unit’s attacks have: ▪ +1 S. ▪ [Lethal Hits].

stratagem.name: TRANSHUMAN REACTIONS
stratagem.lore: Seemingly with the speed of instinct, these warriors reposition in response to the enemy’s movements.
stratagem.when: Your opponent’s Movement phase, when an enemy unit ends a move within 8" of a friendly unengaged PHOBOS unit.
stratagem.effect: Your unit can make a normal move of: ▪ Up to D6". ▪ Or: If the tactical doctrine is active for your unit, up to 6".

stratagem.name: UMBRAL EVASION
stratagem.lore: A combination of technological arcana and expert training help these warriors to evade the eyes of the foe.
stratagem.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly PHOBOS unit.
stratagem.effect: Ranged attacks that target your unit have -1 to hit rolls.
